WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'missing') AS bats_hand,
         COUNT(*) AS fielding_count
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(fielding_count) AS avg_count
  FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT h.bats_hand,
       h.fielding_count,
       CAST(h.fielding_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share,
       h.fielding_count - t.avg_count AS above_avg
FROM hand_counts h
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE h.fielding_count > t.avg_count;
